2014_spells.investiture-of-wind.effectSu: Deal 2d10 bludgeoning damage to a target within Self
2014_spells.investiture-of-wind.fullDesc: Using 1 action, • You can use your action to create a 15-foot cube of swirling wind centered on you. If a Large or smaller creature fails the saving throw, that creature is also pushed up to 10 feet away from you; A creature takes 2d10 bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Until the spell ends, wind whirls around you, and you gain the following benefits: • Ranged weapon attacks made against you have disadvantage on the attack roll; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
